questions.stem: The mitral valve opens at which point of the cardiac cycle?
options: When LV pressure exceeds aortic pressure
When LV pressure falls below LA pressure
At the peak of the T wave
At the onset of the QRS complex
questions.explanation: At the end of isovolumic relaxation, LV pressure falls below LA pressure, and the mitral valve opens. This starts rapid ventricular filling, which is the E wave on Doppler.
Isovolumic contraction occurs between mitral valve closure and aortic valve opening. All valves are closed, so pressure rises quickly while volume stays the same.

questions.stem: Which Doppler wave represents left atrial contraction across the mitral valve?
questions.explanation: The mitral inflow A wave occurs in late diastole, when the atrium contracts. It follows the P wave on the ECG. The E wave represents early passive filling.

questions.stem: Normal right ventricular systolic pressure in an adult is approximately:
questions.explanation: Normal RV systolic pressure (which equals PA systolic pressure without pulmonic stenosis) is about 15-30 mmHg. On echo it is estimated as 4(TR Vmax)² + RA pressure.
